title: V5-C3 Bounded A2A Trust Evidence Envelope
description: Evidence for comparing delegated intent with observed execution. This is NOT an agent-to-agent communication protocol: it carries no discovery, routing, capability advertisement, task lifecycle or transport. It describes a delegation that happened by some other means, what was observed of its execution, what proves that observation, and whether the observed execution stayed inside the delegation.

recordedAt.description: When this envelope was assembled. Informational; not a verification input.

delegation.description: Section 1 - what was authorized. Identity, scope, chain and expiry are REFERENCED from agent-identity.schema.json and deliberately not re-modelled here.

delegationScope.description: Mirrors agent-identity delegation_scope in shape. Authoritative values come from the referenced identity, not from this envelope.

requestedOutput.description: What the delegator asked to receive. NEVER merge this with observation.observedOutcome: a single 'output' field is how post-execution evidence collapses back into self-report.

expiresAt.description: Delegation expiry. Null means the referenced identity governs expiry.

delegationChain.description: Ordered agent ids from the root delegator to targetAgent inclusive.

observation.description: Section 2 - what actually happened, as observed rather than as reported by the actor being described.

observedOutcome.description: The observed result. 'unknown' is a first-class, recordable state following execution_outcome_unknown: a contradictory or missing observation must never be forced into success or failure.

unknownReason.description: Required to be non-empty exactly when status is unknown.

effectSummary.description: Bounded, non-identifying description of the observed effect. Raw records never appear here.

observedBy.description: Who made the observation. Recorded because an observation made by the executing agent is weaker evidence than one made by a party it does not control; this schema records that difference rather than resolving it.

evidence.description: Section 3 - what proves the observation. An observation without evidence binding must be structurally distinguishable from one with it.

evidenceRefs.description: May be empty, which is exactly the missing-evidence case reconciliation must fail closed on.

trustReceipt.description: Reference to the HUQAN trust receipt backing this observation. Null is the unbacked case and must fail closed.

reconciliation.description: Section 4 - did observed execution stay inside the delegation. This is the verdict of the envelope and the reason it exists.

verdict.description: Reuses the canonical set from lib/verdict/action-verdict.js. A parallel status vocabulary is forbidden.

checkResult.description: unknown is never treated as pass.

agentRef.description: Reference into agent-identity.schema.json. Identity, scope, chain and expiry are authoritative THERE; this envelope only points at them.

actionDescriptor.description: What was asked for, or what was seen. Deliberately minimal: no task lifecycle state, no routing, no capability negotiation.
